data.title: Rejection of resident parking permit (Bewohnerparkausweis) application for zone B4
data.summary: The City of Beispielingen's road traffic authority (Straßenverkehrsbehörde) rejected the applicant's 21 July 2025 request for a resident parking permit for zone B4 for the vehicle with plate BGN-AM 740, because the car is registered to Beispiel Pflegedienst GmbH and permanent private use by the applicant was not proven. No fee was charged for this decision.
data.explanation: The city has refused your resident parking permit because the car is registered to a company, not to you, and you have not shown that you permanently use it privately. You do not need to do anything if you accept this. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) — the app will show you the deadline. The objection must be made in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or recorded in person at the city offices. If you miss the deadline, the rejection becomes final. No fee was charged for the decision itself.
